24207-punch-or-the-london-charivari-may-.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. arxiv-1610-01900.title: Distance rationalization of anonymous and homogeneous voting rules Thanks: MW thanks Elchanan Mossel and Miklos Racz for research hospitality and useful conversations.
arxiv-1610-01900.creator: Benjamin Hadjibeyli, Mark C. Wilson
arxiv-1610-01900.description: Abstract . The concept of distance rationalizability of voting rules has been explored in recent years by several authors. Roughly speaking, we first choose a consensus set of elections (defined via preferences of voters over candidates) for which the result is specified a priori (intuitively, these are elections on which all voters can easily agree on the result).

arxiv-2112-12580.title: Long-Term Productivity Based on Science, not Preference Thanks: Presented at Workshop on the Science of Scientific-Software Development and Use , Sponsored by U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Advanced Scientific Computing Research, Dec 13–15, 2021
arxiv-2112-12580.creator: Spencer Smith, Jacques Carette
arxiv-2112-12580.description: Abstract Our goal is to identify inhibitors and catalysts for productive long-term scientific software development. The inhibitors and catalysts could take the form of processes, tools, techniques, environmental factors (like working conditions) and software artifacts (such as user manuals, unit tests, design documents and code).

arxiv-2209-12903.title: Holographic measurement and bulk teleportation Preprint: BRX-TH-6710, YITP-22-96
arxiv-2209-12903.creator: Stefano Antonini, Gregory Bentsen, ChunJun Cao, Jonathan Harper, Shao-Kai Jian, Brian Swingle
arxiv-2209-12903.description: Abstract Holography has taught us that spacetime is emergent and its properties depend on the entanglement structure of the dual theory. In this paper, we describe how changes in the entanglement due to a local projective measurement (LPM) on a subregion A A of the boundary theory modify the bulk dual spacetime.

arxiv-2308-04544.title: Finding Optimal Pathways in Chemical Reaction Networks Using Ising Machines
arxiv-2308-04544.creator: Yuta Mizuno, Tamiki Komatsuzaki
arxiv-2308-04544.description: Abstract Finding optimal pathways in chemical reaction networks is essential for elucidating and designing chemical processes, with significant applications such as synthesis planning and metabolic pathway analysis. Such a chemical pathway-finding problem can be formulated as a constrained combinatorial optimization problem, aiming to find an optimal combination of chemical reactions connecting starting materials to target materials in a given network.

arxiv-2311-06988.title: Absence of strong magnetic fluctuations or interactions in the normal state of LaNiGa 2
arxiv-2311-06988.creator: P. Sherpa, I. Vinograd, Y. Shi, S. A. Sreedhar, C. Chaffey, T. Kissikov, M.-C. Jung, A. S. Bontana, A. P. Dioguardi, R. Yamamoto, M. Hirata, G. Conti, S. Nemsak, J. R. Badger, P. Klavins, I. Vishik, V. Taufour, N. J. Curro
arxiv-2311-06988.description: Abstract We present nuclear magnetic (NMR) and qudrupole (NQR) resonance and magnetization data in the normal state of the topological crystalline superconductor LaNiGa 2 . We find no evidence of magnetic fluctuations or enhanced paramagnetism. These results suggest that the time-reversal symmetry breaking previously reported in the superconducting state of this material is not driven by strong electron correlations.

arxiv-2404-11417.title: Directional Filter Design and Simulation for Superconducting On-chip Filter-banks
arxiv-2404-11417.creator: Louis H. Marting, Kenichi Karatsu, Akira Endo, Jochem J. A. Baselmans, Alejandro Pascual Laguna
arxiv-2404-11417.description: Abstract Many superconducting on-chip filter-banks suffer from poor coupling to the detectors behind each filter. This is a problem intrinsic to the commonly used half wavelength filter, which has a maximum theoretical coupling of 50 %. In this paper we introduce a phase coherent filter, called a directional filter, which has a theoretical coupling of 100 %.

arxiv-2512-16874.title: Pixel Seal : Adversarial-only training for invisible image and video watermarking
arxiv-2512-16874.creator: Tomáš Souček, Pierre Fernandez, Hady Elsahar, Sylvestre-Alvise Rebuffi, Valeriu Lacatusu, Tuan Tran, Tom Sander, Alexandre Mourachko
arxiv-2512-16874.description: Abstract Invisible watermarking is essential for tracing the provenance of digital content. However, training state-of-the-art models remains notoriously difficult, with current approaches often struggling to balance robustness against true imperceptibility. This work introduces Pixel Seal , which sets a new state-of-the-art for image and video watermarking.

CORWIN, THOMAS (1794–1865), American statesman and orator, was born in Bourbon county, Kentucky, on the 29th of July 1794. pmc-12506302.title: How do medical professionals justify their involvement with live tissue training?
pmc-12506302.creator: C S Swain, G Helgesson
pmc-12506302.description: Background“Live tissue training” (LTT) is simulation that uses a live anaesthetised animal in place of a human patient. It is a training practice which is significantly contested, but continues to occur despite availability of alternative simulator models. The aim of this study was to explore if, and how, medical professionals who participate in LTT justify their own professional involvement.

pmc-12514842.description: Acylpeptide hydrolase (APEH) or acylaminoacyl‐peptidase (AAP) is a serine hydrolase that regulates protein metabolism. It can also bind to and process unusual substrates, acting as a detoxifier. uslaw-usc-t12-s216a.title: 12 U.S.C. § 216a — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t12-s216a.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s216a.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 2 (National Banks); Subchapter XVII (Disposition Of Unclaimed Property Recovered From Closed National Banks). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For purposes of this subchapter— (1) the term “Comptroller” means the Comptroller of the Currency; (2) the term “unclaimed property” means any articles, items, assets, other property, or the proceeds thereof from safe deposit.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior is authorized and directed to make an examination of Jamestown Island, parts of the city of Williamsburg, and the Yorktown battlefield, all in the State of Virginia, and areas for highways.
